correctness_confidence.basis: Lean 4.35.0 formalization with 18 zero-sorry theorems and exact-Q certificate verifier checking all rational invariants with 100% red-team rejection.

novelty.basis: Pioneering end-to-end machine-checked audit stack for AI-discovered multi-round entropy-deficit proofs in communication complexity.

reproducibility.basis: Fully reproducible via standalone Lean module, exact-Q verifier, 16 canonical certificates, and automated red-team test suite.

rigor.basis: Comprehensive exact rational arithmetic (Python fractions), zero floating-point numbers, structured JSON verification, and 63/63 live adversarial attack rejection.

significance.basis: Bridges AI-originated complexity proofs with rigorous proof assistants and exact verifiers, solidifying the Omega(n^{2/3}) GHD disambiguation lower bound.

strengths: Rigorous red-team evaluation with 63/63 malicious payloads rejected.
Clear integration of AI-discovered proofs with formal proof assistants.
strong_novelty_candidates: Zero-dependency formal verification stack for multi-round entropy-deficit communication complexity arguments
summary: The paper presents an exemplary formal verification and exact rational audit stack for Dahiya et al.'s Omega(n^{2/3}) Gap Hamming Distance disambiguation lower bound. Combining 18 zero-sorry Lean 4 theorems, an exact-Q certificate verifier, and a comprehensive adversarial red-team suite, the work establishes high standards for verifying AI-originated complexity proofs.
weaknesses: Does not re-formalize continuous binary-entropy calculus or measure-theoretic concentration inside Lean 4, relying on discrete rational bottlenecks.
